description: This bar chart, titled "QA-1" and labeled as a "Financial QA-1 evaluation," presents performance metrics for three different Korean language models on a specific question-answering task, with the vertical axis listing the models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—in descending order of their overall performance. The horizontal axis represents performance, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, as indicated by the values shown within each segmented bar. The bars are stacked horizontally and divided into three colored segments corresponding to the legend: dark purple for "Correct," medium blue for "Partially Correct," and light blue for "Incorrect." For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the performance is composed of 0.88 Correct, 0.08 Partially Correct, and 0.04 Incorrect. EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows 0.96 Correct, 0 Partially Correct, and 0.04 Incorrect. RedWhale (our) also shows 0.96 Correct, 0 Partially Correct, and 0.04 Incorrect. The chart visually emphasizes that both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) achieved perfect scores in the "Partially Correct" category, with no "Partially Correct" responses, while Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B had a significant portion of its performance categorized as "Partially Correct."
